note: Race 3 has no published start time, so its forecast is read at an estimated 16:30Z first beat. Across a 15:00-17:00Z window the bias only moves between +12.9 and +10.7, so the finding that race 3 is markedly less biased than races 1 and 2 does not depend on that guess.
trend: The bias is not a constant. It ran +19.1, +18.0, +11.2 across the three races — shrinking through the afternoon as the model backed further than the water did. Treat 16 deg as a centre, not a fixed offset, and expect the early races of a day to need the larger correction.
